decisions.rationale: The chequing account shows about $101,000 with over three months of history, only payroll and small transfers as deposits, covering the $62,000 down payment and closing costs.
Meridian Real Estate Appraisers is on the panel, the report (2026-05-07) is about six weeks old, and the $621,000 value supports the $620,000 price with no conditions.
TDS is about 47.3% (GDS about 35.5%), above the 44% maximum, driven by the $1,361.40 card payment.
